item.title: Barracuda Flaws Could Be Chained to Bypass Authorization and Gain Root Access
item.description: Barracuda has disclosed details of two vulnerabilities affecting its products that, if chained together, could allow an attacker to bypass authorization controls and gain root access to a susceptible device. The vulnerabilities, a pre-authentication authorization bypass vulnerability and a command injection vulnerability, have been assigned the CVE identifiers CVE-2026-116606 (CVSS score: 9.3)

item.title: How Absorption Rate Reveals Vulnerability Management Health
item.description: AI is accelerating vulnerability discovery, but it is not equally accelerating every part of vulnerability management. Findings and vendor fixes can now arrive at machine speed. Testing, deployment, and verification still depend on the infrastructure of a slower era. So, are you resolving vulnerabilities at least as fast as validated findings enter the system?
